body: ### All Submissions: - [x] Have you followed the guidelines stated in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reflex-dev/reflex/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) file? - [x] Have you checked to ensure there aren't any other open [Pull Requests](https://github.com/reflex-dev/reflex/pulls) for the desired changed? ### Type of change - [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) ### Changes To Core Features: - [x] Have you added an explanation of what your changes do and why you'd like us to include them? - [x] Have you written new tests for your core changes, as applicable? - [x] Have you successfully ran tests with your changes locally? ## What goes wrong When `rx.download` gets a state Var as `data`, it builds the URL as `"data:," + JSON.stringify(var)` and does not percent-encode it. In a `data:` URL, `#` starts the fragment, so everything after the first `#` in the JSON is dropped, and `%XX` sequences are decoded. The documented table example (`rx.download(data=TableDownloadState.users, filename="data.json")`, in `docs/library/tables-and-data-grids/table.md`) therefore downloads a truncated, invalid JSON file whenever a row contains a `#`, such as an address like `12 Main St #4` or a hex color. Node's `fetch` follows the same data-URL rules as the browser: ``` data = [{"address": "12 Main St #4", "note": "100%25 sure"}] before: [{"address":"12 Main St after: [{"address":"12 Main St #4","note":"100%25 sure"}] ``` ## Fix Wrap the stringified value in `encodeURIComponent(...)`. Data that is already a `data:` URI is still passed through unchanged. The `str` and `bytes` paths already base64-encode their data, so they don't change. ## Tests - `tests/units/test_event.py::test_download_var_data_is_percent_encoded` pins the generated expression. - `tests/units/test_event.py::test_download_var_data_url_keeps_hash_and_percent` evaluates the generated URL in Node, which the test skips if Node isn't installed, as `tests/units/reflex_base/test_client_event_queue.py` does. It reads the URL back with `fetch` and asserts the bytes are exactly the original JSON. - Both fail on `main` (`fe2a78f4`). The Node test fails with `JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string` because the download was cut off at `#`. Both pass with the fix. Checks, all run locally: - `uv run pytest tests/units`: 9845 passed. - `pre-commit run --from-ref HEAD~1 --to-ref HEAD`: ruff-format, ruff-check, codespell, update-pyi-files, pyright and ty all pass. - A news fragment is added under `packages/reflex-base/news/`. AI disclosure: an AI agent (Claude) found this bug and wrote the patch and tests, operating the `breken-ai` account. I reviewed the diff adversarially before opening this PR. I'll respond to review feedback, including Greptile/Copilot.
title: fix: percent-encode Var data in rx.download so # and % don't corrupt the file
